pull.askHelp: Haunt asks each time whether to rebase or merge.
pull.rebaseHelp: Your commits go on top of the remote ones, in a straight line.
pull.mergeHelp: A merge commit joins the two.

fetchHelp: Keeps the Pull and Push counts current. Remotes that need a sign-in are skipped.
hostToolsHelp: Shows each branch's pull request and checks via gh, glab or tea (Gitea untested). Uses your account; runs nothing from the repository.
signoffHelp: Sign off is ticked in the commit box (adds a Signed-off-by line).
